Can't confirm without a test run — haven't seen this executed.

Also, need the spec before calling it right either way. `retries > 3` allows attempts at retries=0,1,2,3 (4 total) before returning null. `retries >= 3` cuts it to 3 attempts (0,1,2). That's not just tightening an off-by-one, it changes the max retry count by one. Which one does the ticket actually say — 3 attempts or 4?

If you've got a test asserting the exact expected count, show me the result and I'll say whether it's fixed. Otherwise this is a guess dressed as a fix.
